title: Check out a whole cart in one request
description: Adds POST /api/orders/batch for the cart page: it takes `items`, up to 20 `{ productId, quantity }`, and places the cart's orders together. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: Orders are created one at a time outside a transaction, and a missing product is only noticed when the loop reaches it, so the request answers 404 but the earlier items' orders stay placed (as they do if a later create fails). Check every product before creating anything, and create the orders in one transaction.
